team.name: Bayesian Bullfrogs
team.identity: We're the Bayesian Bullfrogs: a patient, evidence-first desk. We price things before we buy them, size small when the evidence is thin, and hold cash without embarrassment when nothing clears our bar. Every trade states its edge in plain words, and every player has a pre-registered bench rule. We'd rather post an honest +2% than a lucky +20%.
